_doc: tier: safe = deleted by the background task; cache = regenerable, deleted on request; review = real files, quarantined (restorable) on request, never automatic. Paths are globs. %VAR% expands; {drive} repeats the pattern for every fixed drive (e.g. D:\); {downloads} is the user's Downloads folder wherever it lives. min_age_days uses the NEWEST file inside an item. report_only rules are measured and explained but never touched.

rules.name: App crash dumps
rules.why: Memory dumps from crashed programs, only needed when debugging that crash.

rules.name: WSL crash dumps
rules.why: Dumps from crashed Linux processes under WSL.

rules.name: Stale WSL swap disks
rules.why: Swap disks left by earlier WSL sessions. A live one is locked and skipped.

rules.name: Old temp files
rules.why: Leftovers from installers and apps, untouched for 3+ days.

rules.name: Explorer thumbnail cache
rules.why: Rebuilt automatically when folders are opened. Files in use are skipped.

rules.name: Windows temp
rules.why: System temp files older than 3 days.

rules.name: Windows Update download cache
rules.why: Payloads of updates that are already installed.

rules.name: Delivery Optimization cache
rules.why: Update pieces Windows shares with other PCs; refilled when needed.

rules.name: Windows error reports
rules.why: Error reports already sent or never needed.

rules.name: Browser caches (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi)
rules.why: Web page cache. Logins, passwords and history are NOT touched; sites load a bit slower once.

rules.name: Firefox cache
rules.why: Web page cache. Logins, passwords and history are NOT touched.

rules.name: Code editor caches (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf)
rules.why: Editor caches and old logs; settings and extensions stay.

rules.name: Graphics shader caches (DirectX, NVIDIA, AMD)
rules.why: Compiled shaders; games rebuild them, the first launch may stutter briefly.

rules.name: App caches (Discord, Adobe media, old web cache)
rules.why: Images and media previews the apps download or build again; nothing you made is touched.

rules.name: Steam shader caches (all drives)
rules.why: Pre-compiled shaders Steam downloads again for each game.

rules.name: npm cache
rules.why: Downloaded npm packages; re-downloaded on demand.

rules.name: pnpm store (unused packages)
rules.why: Prunes only packages no project references.

rules.name: uv (Python) cache
rules.why: Prunes unused wheels; installed environments keep working.

rules.name: pip cache
rules.why: Downloaded Python wheels.

rules.name: Yarn cache
rules.why: Downloaded packages.

rules.name: Gradle caches (30+ days)
rules.why: Android/Java build caches untouched for 30 days.

rules.name: NuGet cache (30+ days)
rules.why: .NET packages untouched for 30 days.

rules.name: Recycle Bin (all drives)
rules.why: Files you already deleted.

rules.name: Old installers in Downloads (30+ days)
rules.why: Setup files are rarely needed after installing. Quarantined, restorable.

rules.name: Hugging Face AI models (30+ days unused)
rules.why: Downloaded AI models; re-downloading is large.

rules.name: Previous Windows installation (Windows.old)
rules.why: Left after a Windows upgrade; needed only to roll back. Remove it with Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files > Previous Windows installation(s).

rules.name: Windows upgrade leftovers
rules.why: Setup files from a finished Windows upgrade. Remove them with Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files.
